rubric_items.reason: The design uses only existing modules and layers: router, service, repos, dayBounds, client.ts, todayIn, Pagination and the existing appointment index. It adds no new route, store or migration, and it follows the routes/services/repositories layout.

The story map covers S-1, S-2 and S-3. Each S-1 AC maps to dayBounds, CANCELLED exclusion, the 0 default and the Q-02 handling. S-2 maps to the doctor_id/date link and S-3 to the unchanged DoctorRepo, Pagination and columns. The Q-02 default now matches the stories' Q-05.

The interface is now named and typed: with_today (boolean, default false), today_count (integer, 0 or more), DoctorListRow, countTodayByDoctor(doctorIds, from, to) with its SQL predicate, and the link /appointments?doctor_id=<id>&date=<YYYY-MM-DD>.

Facts are cited, and the proposed names, filters, time-zone source and tile rule are asked in Q-01 to Q-05. The picker call is now sourced to impact. One small gap: the web generic Page<T> is used without a cited fact.

There are four trade-offs: separate query vs join, opt-in vs always on, list-only type vs shared type, and the status rule. Each gives a reason and a cost, including the possible temporary mismatch with the tile.
The flow is clear and numbered. The component and endpoint status in the front matter matches the body. DashboardService and AppointmentsPage now say when they would become changed.
